festivals.name: St. Johns Music Fest
festivals.blurb: Three days of free live music in twenty rooms, patios and food-cart pods across St. Johns, put on by Havalina. Walk between sets.

festivals.name: Northwest Roots Fest
festivals.blurb: Two days of ska, reggae and roots at The Haven, presented by Impact! Sound and Kingston Beat. Saturday 4pm–midnight, Sunday 2pm–10pm. All ages.

festivals.name: Easyfolk Fest
festivals.blurb: Portland's all-local folk fest: seven performances over two evening showcases at the Winningstad, put on by Easyfolk (now a nonprofit). Single-day tickets or a 2-day pass.

festivals.name: Portland's Folk Festival
festivals.blurb: Two days of folk at the Crystal Ballroom, with the PFF Songwriting Contest winners on Saturday. Friday 5pm doors, 6pm show; Saturday 2pm doors, 3pm show. All ages. Early-bird and 2-day passes; more acts to be announced.
